parts:
Hi
 
I try to incorporate a carousel (bxslider) in my shiny site.

tags$script(src='js/jquery.bxslider.min.js'),
#tags$script(src='js/jquery-1.11.1.min.js'),

I suspect a conflict between the js files. I try with version //ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.8.2/jquery.min.js without succes

Can someone help me
Great thank you in advance
 
Alain
